reason: An ambient soundtrack plugin that requests tracks from AudioLib.ai and controls local audio playback according to agent session state, with explicit model tools for play, stop, and status.

summaries.zh: 根据智能体会话状态从 AudioLib.ai 获取环境音乐，并通过本地播放器进行播放控制。
summaries.en: Provides ambient soundtrack playback from AudioLib.ai, adapting local audio to the agent’s session state with controls for play, stop, and status.

capabilities: Calls the AudioLib.ai API to request audio tracks
Plays audio through a configured local player such as mpv, ffplay, or afplay
Responds to session turn events to select ambient or working-state playback
Exposes music_play, music_stop, and music_status model tools
Uses a configured API credential and may download tracks to temporary files for file-only players
